versions.description: Chat runs an agent as a process and speaks the Agent Client Protocol to it, so the conversation happens here rather than in a terminal beside here. Which agents it can raise is a fact about this machine, not about this build: the ones that are installed are offered, the ones that are not say what is missing, and Codex — which does not speak the protocol at all — is reached through a bridge that ships inside the application. Where an agent offers its models in protocol, they are listed as it stated them; where it takes one only at launch, that is said instead of a picker that could not work. A conversation belongs to the project rather than to the screen: switching sections leaves the agent working, and coming back finds everything it said meanwhile.
versions.changelog:
The archive now carries the stylesheet it declares.

`1.0.0` named `ui/index.css` in its manifest and did not contain it, so Sync
refused to open the package after downloading it — the download succeeded, the
sha256 matched the registry, and the install failed at the last step. Nothing in
the extension itself changed.
